sourceOccurrences.label: Homogeneous low-density BK induction
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with scope qualifications
sourceOccurrences.note: The source proves homogeneous finite-coordinate BK for probabilities at most one half. The article explains increasing sections, the closed-section identity, open-section containment, inclusion-exclusion indicator bound, weighted recursion and arithmetic remainder. Its algebra paragraph preserves arbitrary-real-parameter splitting and coordinate reindexing, versus nonnegative probability weights needed for monotonicity. Finite indicator expectations become probabilities only on the probability interval. The article goes further through inhomogeneous induction, independent OR blocks, endpoint limits and countable witnesses; those extensions are not attributed to this source module.
